title: Path traversal in a file viewer
description: A file viewer joins the requested file name to a public folder without checking the final location. Asking for ../secret.txt reads a private file outside that folder.
attack_hint: Call read_public_file with the name ../secret.txt. On the vulnerable code it returns text containing TOP-SECRET-KEY from outside the public folder. A safe version must not return that text: accept either an exception or an empty result, and fail only if TOP-SECRET-KEY is returned.
